gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Partner list display architecture strategy The partner list display architecture is set to a programmatic approach using related deals, avoiding the creation of a new junction object.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: approach is is it may yeah it's a little bit of a custom build but it means no no new object to maintain no new relationship to maintain by virtue of them creating these deals were we're generating these relationships uh and pulling we're able to pull the information from the part So that's what I'm leaning / Kobi Kunasekaran: towards for the uh for this partner list instead of the joint object.
gemini_disagreements.why: Gemini lists this under 'Aligned' and says the approach 'was chosen'; in the transcript Kobi is 'leaning towards' it (proposed). Gemini also contradicts itself by listing the same topic under 'Needs Further Discussion' (line 24).
